cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Rank Everything
cards.instruction: Turn every new contribution into a ranking that places you nearer the top.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's handle this professionally. For the project report, my printer troubleshooting ranks above your restart suggestion.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The restart got everyone's invoices printed.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can explain the standard again. Slowly. Implementation: second place. Identifying the blockage stays first.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Your hundred-page lunch menu was the blockage.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then move my stress testing above troubleshooting. Your restart is third.

confusable: D65 frames defeat as concession; D67 constructs an explicit hierarchy from every contribution, always placing A higher.
comparison: Picnic alternative ranks useful work; printer alternative reclassifies culpable overload as highest-level stress testing.
seedUse: Printer report, restart, invoices and hundred-page menu derive from D67-b; S03 adds precise contribution labels and report correction.
